infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SpatiaLore uses your location to detect when you're near a point of interest and play the audio narration automatically.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: SpatiaLore needs background location access to play tour narration automatically while your phone is locked or in your pocket, without you needing to keep the app open.
